notes.text: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
Students must complete a minimum of 128 units with a Pacific cumulative and school/program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the bachelor of science in business administration degree.

For more details, see General Education
Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include:
CORE Seminars (2 courses)

Notes:
1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 
2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.
Diversity and Inclusion Requirement

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)
Note: Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.
Fundamental Skills

Students must demonstrate competence in:
Writing
Quantitative Analysis (Math)
Note: Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.
Core Area Concentrations

Complete one of the four concentrations i.e. Finance, Marketing, Business Analytics, Management and Human Resources from the sections 6-10 of this template.
Note: 
1) A student is required to take at least four courses in a major, one of which must be an international concentration course. 2) A number of majors require more than four courses.
